Title: Vikram and the Family

Cast

1. Vikram - 36 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Pallavi - 56 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Sonali - 26 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Vikram stands by the road. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "Vikram, what's the plan today?"

[Vikram rides his motorbike to the market.]

Vikram: "Hey, look at that!"

[Vikram starts his scooter and rides off.]

Vikram (gently): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Vikram drives the car to the office.]

Vikram (softly): "Well done!"

[Vikram gets out of the car.]

Vikram (softly): "What a day to remember!"
